style_context: Organized sports participation, athlete training, injury prevention, equipment, and healthy performance habits

images.description: Top-down view of an open sports first-aid kit on a clean bench with elastic wrap, instant cold pack, gauze pads, athletic tape, blister pads, antiseptic wipes, and a labeled water bottle, with simple callouts pointing to each item, no branding or decorative text
images.value: Shows the actual appearance and grouping of core sports first-aid items in one glance, helping the reader recognize what belongs in a ready-to-use kit

images.description: Clean overhead diagram of a balanced athlete meal on a plate divided into grains, lean protein, vegetables, and fruit with a water bottle beside it, each section labeled with short single-word labels, bright simple educational layout
images.value: Shows the visual balance of food groups on one plate, making proportion and meal composition easier to understand than text alone

images.description: Simple planning worksheet diagram comparing two sports options side by side with clearly separated boxes for practice schedule, equipment, travel, competitions, and counselor approval, minimal horizontal labels only, no branding
images.value: Shows how to compare two sports across practical planning factors in one visual layout, helping the reader structure a realistic choice

images.description: Clean example sports field diagram with boundary lines, center area, scoring zones, sidelines, and player starting positions, viewed from above with short horizontal labels and arrows kept minimal, educational black-and-color linework
images.value: Shows how a playing-area diagram should organize boundaries, zones, and positions spatially, which is hard to teach clearly with prose alone
